_comment_top: spaarkeai-assistant-enhancements-r3 task 021 (FR-07 — overview parity across ALL grids + Briefing + Calendar). Seed row for the spaarke.daily_briefing_overview tool — the Lane-3 (composed-service) parity-tool backing for the Daily Briefing layout tab. Grids + Calendar reuse spaarke.grid_overview (task 020) via configId (see sprk_analysistool-grid-overview-row.json); Daily Briefing's counts are NOT a single FetchXML saved query (BriefingService aggregates PortfolioService data + a membership-resolved top-priority-matter heuristic + an optional AI narrative), so it gets its OWN thin wrapper tool per the design.md §5 Lane 3 guidance ('a parity tool wraps the service directly — no reinvention'). This is NOT a new aggregate endpoint and NOT a per-grid handler — it wraps the EXISTING BriefingService.GetBriefingAsync used by the Quick Summary card / briefing dialog (GET /api/workspace/briefing).
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to DailyBriefingOverviewHandler via sprk_handlerclass. Auto-discovered (ADR-010). The deterministic ADR-039 PreFilter/catalog projects the LLM-facing function name from sprk_toolid — NO classifier, NO second dispatch surface.
_comment_obo: project MUST rule: BriefingService resolves the caller's own briefing from the chat principal's AAD oid (ChatInvocationContext.UserId) — the SAME per-user identity the Quick Summary card / briefing dialog already use (ADR-028). No app-only fallback; a missing user id fails closed.
_comment_side_effect: sprk_sideeffectclass = 100000000 (Read). The tool only reads the caller's existing briefing; it performs no writes.
_comment_grounding: ADR-039/ADR-015 grounding: when a top-priority matter is present its Dataverse record id is echoed as a citation (tables/sprk_matter/records/{id}). Telemetry logs the user id + counts + duration ONLY — never the narrative text (may be AI-generated free text) and never matter names.
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — UPSERT by sprk_handlerclass + sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' filter.
sprk_description: Answers Daily Briefing overview questions (active matter count, matters at risk, overdue events, portfolio spend/budget utilization, and the current narrative) for the calling user, sourced from the SAME BriefingService the Quick Summary card and briefing dialog use — never from a prompt snapshot. Use this whenever the user asks to summarize their daily briefing counts, portfolio health, or 'what needs my attention'. Takes NO arguments — the briefing is always for the calling user. This tool runs under the CALLING USER's identity (OBO) automatically — you already know who the user is; NEVER ask the user for their user id, name, or 'who they are' to scope results. Returns { activeMatters, mattersAtRisk, overdueEvents, totalSpend, totalBudget, utilizationPercent, topPriorityMatter, narrative } — narrate the counts and cite the top-priority matter's record id when present; do not invent numbers.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only — this tool exists for the agent loop (P2), not playbook nodes.

sprk_jsonschema.title: spaarke.daily_briefing_overview Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: No arguments — the briefing is always resolved for the calling (authenticated) user.

activeMatters.description: Count of matters with an active/open status.

mattersAtRisk.description: Count of matters where overdueeventcount > 0 or utilization > 85%.

overdueEvents.description: Total count of overdue events across all active matters.

totalSpend.description: Sum of all invoiced amounts across active matters.

totalBudget.description: Sum of all budget amounts across active matters.

utilizationPercent.description: Portfolio-level spend / budget expressed as a percentage.

citationPath.description: tables/sprk_matter/records/{id} — cite this when narrating the top-priority matter.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this briefing was generated/cached.

sprk_configuration._comment: No configId, no method-discriminator dispatch — a single, argument-free LLM-facing function scoped to the calling user.
